The '''WTK-85A interstellar transport''' was a model of [[transport]] manufactured by [[Sublights Products Corporation]]. Designed for [[scout]]s or [[pilot]]s who worked with minimal crew requirements, the WTK-85A only needed one pilot, though had space for a co-pilot.

==Characteristics==
[[File:BestoonLegacy-CGSWG.png|thumb|left|250px|Aft view of the WTK-85A transport ''Bestoon Legacy'']]
Designed for scouts and lone pilots, the ship only needed one pilot, but was demanded by safety requirements to have copilot station with a redundant controls. The massive engines that flanked the ship were a combination of sublight and hyperspace drives. The ship had a modern [[Navigation computer|navicomputer]] which was useful for loners, and speeds that could approach a [[starfighter]] in [[atmosphere]].<ref name="CVNE" />

==History==
The transport was originally designed during the last days of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CVNE" />

A WTK-85A was part of [[Zorby's Western Shiplot]], a [[starship]] lot on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]].<ref name="Kassa">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}</ref> 

A WTK-85A was parked outside the gates of [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's palace]] when the [[slicer]] [[Kay Vess]] and the [[bounty hunter]] [[Vail Tormin]] were escaping.<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref> 

The [[Sith]] [[assassin]] [[Ochi]] owned a modified WTK-85A interstellar transport, the ''[[Bestoon Legacy]]''. The craft was briefly stolen by Rey's parents, [[Miramir]] and [[Dathan]], to return Rey to the [[planet]] [[Jakku]], only for Ochi to [[Death|kill]] them and reclaim his ship. Traveling to the planet [[Pasaana]] on a false lead on Rey's location,<ref name="Shadow of the Sith">''[[Shadow of the Sith]]''</ref> Ochi died after sinking in the [[Shifting Mires]], leaving his ship behind.<ref name="TROS VD" /> Eventually during a [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|Mission to Pasaana]], [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] piloted the ship to save [[Chewbacca]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
